name: Raise Moon - The City that Never Sleeps
effectText:
The first time each Level 7 "Raise Moon" monster you control would be destroyed by card effect each turn, it is not destroyed. Once per turn: You can activate 1 of these effects;
●Place 1 card from your hand on the top or bottom of the Deck, then draw 1 card.
●If you control a Spellcaster "Raise Moon" Xyz Monster: Draw 1 card.
Once per turn, during the End Phase: Shuffle all "Raise Moon" cards from your GY and banishment into the Deck.
